label: GATHERINGS & BELONGING
相聚与连接
title: Summer gatherings in 2024 and 2025
2024与2025年的夏日相聚
summary: Small summer gatherings in 2024 and 2025 offered a relaxed setting for conversation and time together.
2024与2025年的小型夏日聚会，为交流与相伴提供轻松的场景。
question: How can a community make space for informal connection?
社群如何为自然发生的交流，留出空间？
why: Alongside reading and structured discussions, Hotwind also made room for informal gatherings. The supplied photographs show people sharing a table, preparing the space and spending a summer evening together.
在阅读与主题讨论之外，热風也为轻松的相聚保留了空间。照片记录了大家布置现场、围桌交流、一起度过夏日夜晚的片段。

title: Prepare the setting
布置场地
text: A photograph shows a welcome board being prepared for a gathering.
一张照片记录了为聚会准备欢迎板的过程。

title: Gather around a table
围桌相聚
text: Photographs show participants seated together in indoor and outdoor settings.
照片记录了参与者在室内、户外围桌相聚的场景。

title: Keep a record
留下记录
text: The selected posters and photographs provide a record of activities in 2024 and 2025.
精选海报与照片，留下了2024与2025年活动的记录。

role: As founder and team lead, I helped sustain the community and its activities with the core team. These gatherings are shown as collective work.
作为创始人兼负责人，我与核心团队共同维系社群及活动；这里展示的是团队共同完成的相聚。
reflection: A community also grows through ordinary moments: preparing a space, sitting at the same table and having time for one another.
社群也在日常片段中生长：一起准备场地、围坐在同一张桌旁、把时间留给彼此。
evidenceNote: The photographs record selected gatherings across two summers; posters show the way those gatherings were presented. No wellbeing or long-term relationship outcome is measured here.
照片记录两个夏天的部分聚会，海报呈现其宣传方式；这里不据此判断心理健康或长期关系结果。

label: FAMILY & OPEN DIALOGUE
家庭与开放对话
title: Discussing discouraging messages in family upbringing
讨论家庭教育中的打压式表达
shortTitle: 家庭教育与打压式表达讨论
summary: An archived poster and a facilitation outline explore family upbringing, shared reading and open discussion.
通过存档海报与主持提纲，呈现关于家庭教育、共同阅读与开放讨论的活动设计。
question: How can personal experience become a thoughtful public conversation?
如何把个人经历，转化为认真而开放的讨论？
why: The poster invites discussion of discouraging messages in family life. A supporting draft outline proposes a reading-and-discussion format.
海报邀请大家讨论家庭生活中的打压式话语；另有主持提纲草稿提出阅读与讨论相结合的形式。

title: Introduce the theme
引入主题
text: The draft proposes a brief introduction to discouraging language in family upbringing.
草稿提出先简要介绍家庭教育中的打压式表达。

title: Read an excerpt together
共同阅读选段
text: Shared reading is proposed as a starting point for conversation.
提纲把共同阅读选段作为讨论的入口。

title: Invite open discussion
邀请开放讨论
text: The outline describes equal participation rather than an expert-led lecture. It is presented as a proposed format.
提纲描述了平等交流的形式，而非专家单向讲授；这里按设计方案呈现。

role: I helped plan the discussion format with the team. The draft outline names me as the facilitator.
我与团队共同参与讨论形式的设计，提纲草稿将我列为主持人。
reflection: A student-led reading discussion can consider personal experience while keeping a clear boundary from diagnosis, counselling or psychological treatment.
学生主导的阅读讨论可以交流个人经历，同时应与诊断、心理咨询及心理治疗保持清晰边界。
evidence: 活动海报与主持提纲草稿
evidenceNote: The poster and outline document the theme and design. They are not treated as proof that every proposed segment took place or that all versions addressed the same audience.
海报与提纲记录主题和设计，不据此认定所有拟议环节均已实施，或不同版本面向同一受众。
actionsHeading: The format proposed in the facilitation outline
主持提纲中提出的活动形式

label: LISTENING & PROGRAMME DESIGN
倾听与活动设计
title: Planning questions about students’ needs
围绕青年需求，设计调研问题
summary: Summer 2025 planning documents proposed questionnaires and interviews about meaningful social connection and different aspects of student growth.
2025年夏季规划材料提出通过问卷与访谈，了解深度社交及学生不同方面的成长需求。
question: What would students want a community to help them explore?
学生希望一个社群，支持他们探索什么？
why: The planning brief asked whether campus activities supported meaningful connection and different kinds of personal growth. The aim was to let students’ needs inform future activities and the organisation’s structure.
调研提纲关注校园活动是否支持深度连接与不同维度的成长，希望从学生需求反向设计活动与组织运行框架。

title: Define the questions
明确问题
text: Identify two themes: meaningful social connection and multidimensional growth.
明确深度社交与多维度成长两个主题。

title: Explore ways to listen
设计倾听方式
text: Prepare questionnaire ideas and plans for conversations with students from different disciplines and years.
准备问卷构想，并规划与不同年级、不同专业学生的交流。

title: Inform future design
为后续设计提供依据
text: Use the questions to reconsider activities, participation and the community’s operating model.
用这些问题重新思考活动形式、参与方式与社群运行模式。

role: I helped frame the questions and connect the planning work to Hotwind’s development. The material is presented as exploratory planning rather than a completed research study.
我参与梳理问题，并把调研设计与热風的发展联系起来。这里呈现的是探索性规划，并非已完成的研究。
reflection: The planning work helped frame questions for future activities. No draft percentages, proposed sample sizes or questionnaire scores are presented as Hotwind research findings.
这些规划帮助梳理后续活动的问题；草稿中的百分比、拟议样本量或问卷分数，均不作为热風研究结果呈现。
evidenceNote: The supplied documents record questions and proposed methods. They do not establish completed data collection, an achieved sample size or validated findings.
所提供的文档记录了问题与拟议方法，不能据此确认已经完成数据收集、达到特定样本量或获得经验证的研究结果。
